Dev Deepawali Celebrations Illuminate Varanasi with Thousands of Diyas

Varanasi is preparing for Dev Deepawali, an event that will feature the lighting of 51,000 diyas to honor India's heroes. The celebrations are expected to significantly boost tourism and business in Kashi, with projected revenues reaching ₹450-500 crore. The event is scheduled for Dev Deepawali 2026.
